Configure a named standard IPv4 ACL

Configure NAT Pool:

```
(config)# ip nat pool [POOL_NAME] [start-ip] [end-ip] netmask [mask]
```

Bind ACL to NAT Pool. The ACL is a list of inside local IPs eligible for translation, while NAT Pool is a list of inside global IPs that any of the inside local IP addresses can be translated to.

```
(config)# ip nat inside source list [ACL_NAME] pool [POOL_NAME] overload
```

Create a static link for static NAT

```
(config)# ip nat inside source static [inside-local-ip] [inside-global-ip]
```

Configure inside and outside interfaces:

```
(config-if)# ip nat inside/outside
```
